target.title: refactor: consolidate string reader mechanics
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Closes #99663.

The shared-utility audit ranks string option/alias readers fourth with 183 candidates and constrained-string normalization twenty-seventh with 17 candidates. `@openclaw/normalization-core/string-coerce` already owned raw and trimmed string coercion, but callers still repeated first-string alias loops and caller-owned enum membership casts across core, packages, and bundled plugins.

Search proof for this slice:

- 28 production sites used `(VALUES as readonly string[]).includes(...)`; this PR migrates a coherent high-value subset and establishes the canonical narrowing mechanic.
- Alias-loop search found repeated raw/trimmed first-string selection across core and bundled plugins; this PR migrates exact-contract sites only.
- Remaining inventory is intentionally excluded where callers preserve non-empty whitespace, need the matched alias name, apply snake_case lookup policy, or collect multiple values.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds four dependency-free mechanics to the existing normalization owner:

- `isStringOption` and `readStringOption` narrow against caller-owned arrays or sets.
- `readStringAlias` preserves whitespace and empty strings.
- `readTrimmedStringAlias` returns the first trimmed non-empty alias.

Domain enum values, normalization order, defaults, fallbacks, and side effects stay local. Bundled plugins receive only the helpers they actually use through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/string-coerce-runtime`; no broad utility barrel or new dependency is introduced.

The slice updates 23 caller modules plus the canonical implementation, tests, and SDK facade. Production code is `+145/-147`, net **-2 LOC**.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Maintainers and plugin authors get one typed owner for alias selection and constrained-string narrowing, reducing duplicate casts and whitespace-contract drift without changing config, protocol, storage, or defaults.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/normalization-core/src/string-coerce.test.ts src/acp/approval-classifier.test.ts src/agents/mcp-transport-config.test.ts src/infra/net/proxy-env.test.ts src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.minimax.test.ts src/sessions/input-provenance.test.ts src/talk/consult-question.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.act.normalize.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.act.existing-session-navigation-guard.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/suite-runtime-agent-media.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/media-tags.test.ts`
  - 6 Vitest shards, 11 files, 148 tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwn20w85vc0h10bvn0hpbffa`
  - `pnpm check:changed` passed for core, core tests, plugins, and plugin tests.
  - `pnpm build` passed, including plugin SDK export verification.
  - Actions run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28686270573
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --prompt-file /tmp/string-readers-autoreview.md --stream-engine-output`
